summary.bn: ১২ ভোল্টে জোরে বাজে। বোর্ডের পিন এটা চালাতে পারে না: রিলে বা ট্রানজিস্টর দিয়ে চালাও।
summary.en: Sounds loudly on 12 V. A board pin cannot drive it: switch it through a relay or a transistor.

simplified: It sounds while it has at least about 6 V the right way round, and draws about 300 mA at 12 V, as a resistance of 40 Ω: estimates, as sellers' figures differ.
Its sound in the lab is the same tone as the buzzer's.
Wired the wrong way round it stays silent; whether a real one is damaged is not modelled.
